data.name: Khizran
data.gender_notes: Khizran is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khizy' meaning 'to know'. Khizran is a unisex name indicating a treasure trove of knowledge. The name Khizran carries the meaning “Treasure of Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khizran usually hope their child will grow to embody treasure of knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Khizran is an honorific title given to Prophet Enoch (Idris). It signifies divine wisdom and guidance.
data.etymology: Khizran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Treasure of Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khizran total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: خزران
in_arabic.meaning: خزران تعني الورود الجميلة والرائعة في الجنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: خزران هو اسم يدل على الورود الجميلة والرائعة في الجنة، وهو مشتق من كلمة 'خزر' التي تعني الورود الخضراء والزاهية. ورد هذا الاسم في بعض الأحاديث النبوية الشريفة، ويعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية وجميلة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: خزران
in_urdu.meaning: خزران کا مطلب جنت کے خوبصورت پھول ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: خزران ایک ایسا نام ہے جو جنت کے خوبصورت پھولوں کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی جڑ 'خزر' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سبز اور روشن پھول۔ اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں ایک خوبصورت اور روحانی نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: खिज़रान
in_hindi.meaning: खिज़रान का अर्थ स्वर्ग के सुंदर फूल हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: खिज़रान एक ऐसा नाम है जो स्वर्ग के सुंदर फूलों की याद दिलाता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा की जड़ 'खज़र' से मखौल है, जिसका अर्थ है हरे-भरे और शानदार फूल। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक सुंदर और आध्यात्मिक नाम के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: خيزران
in_pashto.meaning: خيزران د جنت ښکلي ګلونه معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: خيزران يو نوم دے چې د جنت ښکلي ګلونو ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د ريښې 'خزر' څخه اخيستل شوی دے، چې د معنی يې ښکلي او شنه ګلونه دي. دا نوم په افغان او پښتون دود کې يو معنوي او ښکلی نوم ګڼل کيږي.

in_english.name: Khizran
in_english.meaning: Khizran means beautiful flowers or blossoms in Paradise
in_english.long_meaning: Khizran is a name that refers to beautiful flowers or blossoms in Paradise. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'kh-z-r', which signifies green and lush flowers. The name holds spiritual significance and connotes beauty, serenity, and bliss. Historically, it has been used in Islamic tradition to denote a peaceful and idyllic existence. The name Khizran symbolizes hope, renewal, and divine grace.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khizran holds a rich cultural influence in the Islamic world, symbolizing the pursuit of wisdom and knowledge. The name evokes images of scholars and revered figures in Islamic history who have dedicated their lives to the acquisition and dissemination of knowledge. It highlights the importance of intellectual curiosity and the pursuit of wisdom in Islamic tradition, which is deeply intertwined with faith and spirituality.
data.spiritual_significance: As a spiritually significant name, Khizran symbolizes the quest for knowledge and the understanding of the divine. The name invokes the image of the well-known figure in Islamic folklore, Al-Khidr, who embodies the wisdom and knowledge granted to him by God. Khizran, as a spiritually significant name, calls forth the wisdom and guidance of the divine in one's own life journey. It represents the belief that knowledge and wisdom are integral to a deeply spiritual and fulfilling existence.
